synopsis: ASAM began QSQ (Quantifying Simulation Quality) to standardize machine-readable simulation-quality metrics with use-case-specific weighting [f4833]. Its proposal workshop took place on 11 September 2025 [f5274]. Chapter 6 describes QSQ as still under way in 2026, alongside a separate ASAM project defining high fidelity for camera, radar and lidar [f4835]. Chapter 7 more specifically describes QSQ as still at proposal stage, so these facts do not establish that finalized metrics were available [f5273, f4835].

relations.note: Proposal-stage status specifies the broader description of QSQ as still under way.
The proposal workshop documents proposal-related activity, consistent with the reported proposal-stage status.
Adds 2026 progress status and distinguishes a separate sensor-fidelity project.
